issue.title: Codex shows 258K instead of 272K for magpie models because catalog omits effective_context_window_percent
issue.body:
### 现象 / Symptom

When Codex is pointed at magpie with `model_catalog_json = "magpie-models.json"`, the Codex UI and `codex debug models` report a 258K context window for a model whose catalog entry says `context_window = 272000`.

Example from a real machine (Windows 11, Codex desktop + magpie Windows build):

```toml
model = "workbuddy/deepseek-v4.1-flash"
model_provider = "magpie"
model_catalog_json = "magpie-models.json"
```

`~/.codex/magpie-models.json`:

```json
{
  "slug": "workbuddy/deepseek-v4.1-flash",
  "context_window": 272000,
  "max_context_window": 1000000
}
```

Observed: Codex uses `258400` (~258K) as the effective context window.

### 根因 / Root cause

Codex's model catalog treats a missing `effective_context_window_percent` as **95%**. So:

`272000 × 95% = 258400`

The magpie catalog entries for magpie-served models currently do **not** write `effective_context_window_percent`, so Codex silently shrinks the declared window.

### 建议修复 / Suggested fix

For catalog entries magpie generates for its own models, write:

```json
"effective_context_window_percent": 100
```

so the window magpie declares is the window Codex actually uses.

As a compatibility fallback for Codex versions/configs that read the top-level `model_context_window` before the catalog, magpie can also mirror the selected model's final catalog window into the top-level `model_context_window` key (only when magpie owns it, and never overwriting a user-set value).

### 验证 / Verification

- `codex debug models` on this machine shows `effective_context_window_percent: 95` while the catalog omits the field.
- With a synthetic catalog that adds `"effective_context_window_percent": 100`, the same `codex debug models` output shows `effective_context_window_percent: 100`.
- The catalog at `~/.codex/magpie-models.json` is regenerated by magpie but is still missing the field after upgrading the running binary, so the fix also needs `SyncCatalog`/`Keep` to emit it into existing catalogs.

Fixed on [fix/codex-context-percent](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/codex-context-percent) (`ce9531f6`, based on `main` `01468003`): the entries magpie generates — the ones whose window magpie writes — now carry `effective_context_window_percent: 100`; Codex's own entries (`ownEntry`) keep the percentage Codex gives them, so upstream semantics are untouched.

- RED → GREEN: `TestCodexCatalogUsesTheWholeWindow` uses your `workbuddy/deepseek-v4.1-flash` (`context_window: 272000`, `max_context_window: 1000000`) as the fixture. On a clean base with only the test added: `effective_context_window_percent` missing from the entry (`percent <nil>, window 272000`); after the change it reads 100 and Codex's effective window is 272000, not 258400. A second case holds Codex's own 95% unchanged.
- `internal/codexcat` passes whole; `go vet`/`go build` (linux, windows, `nogui linux`) clean, `gofmt -l` empty.
- Said plainly: no real Codex client (desktop/CLI) was run; the verification sits at the catalog-generation layer. If your Codex build applies a different default to magpie-generated entries, reply with the version and I'll align.

issue.title: [Bug] Codex catalog: context_window gets the 272000 template value instead of the model's real context

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
Summary

When magpie wires Codex, the generated catalog (magpie-desktop-models.json) gives every non-native model context_window: 272000 while putting the model's real context in max_context_window. Codex reads context_window, so a 1M-context model is shown and used as 272K.

272000 is exactly the context of GPT-5.6-Luna — i.e. the OpenAI template value is being used as the default instead of the vendor's real number that magpie already knows (it writes that number into max_context_window).

Environment

  • magpie 0.1.1734, Windows 11 x64

  • Agent: Codex (ChatGPT desktop app, model_catalog_json = "magpie-desktop-models.json" in ~/.codex/config.toml)

  • Provider: OpenCode Go (opencode.ai), model opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash, routed through openai_base_url = http://127.0.0.1:3425/backend-api/codex

  • Observed 2026-10-28

What happens

Codex shows the model's context window as ~272K (with output reserved, ~258K usable) instead of the 1M the model actually has.

Expected

Codex should show/use 1,000,000 for opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash.

Evidence

1. magpie's own gateway reports the correct number

GET http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1/models:

 {"id":"opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash","context_length":1000000,"context_window":1000000,"max_input":1000000}
 {"id":"opencode-go/deepseek-v4-pro","context_length":1000000,"context_window":1000000,"max_input":1000000}

models.dev, which magpie also uses, agrees — [opencode-go] deepseek-v4.1-flash: limit={"context":1000000,"output":384000}.

2. The generated Codex catalog disagrees

From ~/.codex/magpie-desktop-models.json (generated by magpie, 32 models):

 {
   "slug": "opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash",
   "context_window": 272000,        // <- what Codex reads
   "max_context_window": 1000000    // <- the real value, but Codex does not use it
 }

3. The pattern is systematic — models without max_context_window get the right value

The rule is exact: if max_context_window is emitted, context_window loses its real value and becomes 272000; if it is not emitted, context_window keeps the correct vendor value.

Why 272000

272000 is GPT-5.6-Luna's context (GPT 5.6 Luna (≤ 272K tokens), see also the Go usage table). It looks like the Codex OpenAI template's default window is used as the fallback when a max_context_window is being computed, instead of the model's own limit.context that magpie already has (and correctly writes to max_context_window).

Impact

  • The agent's own context accounting (compaction thresholds, "context left" indicators, /context) is computed from context_window. A 1M model is treated as 272K: Codex compacts far earlier than it needs to, and the difference is invisible in the UI.

  • Users cannot fix it from magpie: magpie codex has no context field (model, effort, subagent, subagent_model, subagent_effort, memories, login), and there is no per-model context override in the provider editor.

  • Workaround users reach for is editing magpie-desktop-models.json, which magpie regenerates.

Suggested fix

When building the Codex catalog entry, take context_window from the model's real context (the same value already written to max_context_window / the vendor's /v1/models context_length), not from the OpenAI template default. max_context_window can stay as the ceiling; context_window should be the effective window.

Optionally: an explicit per-model context override in the provider editor would let users pin a value when a vendor reports one that is too conservative (and would let magpie- regen not fight such a pin).

Reproduction

  1. Add an OpenCode Go provider (opencode.ai/zen/go/v1) with a key.

  2. Set Codex's model to opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash.

  3. Open ~/.codex/magpie-desktop-models.json and read that entry: context_window = 272000 while max_context_window = 1000000.

  4. Codex shows ~272K for a 1M model.

Notes

  • Filed from a real setup; no crafted case. Verified by reading magpie's own /v1/models, models.dev, and the generated catalog on the same machine.

  • The same 272000 appears for the native gpt-6-luna, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-reserve, codex-auto-review rows too — with max_context_window 872000. If the template value is intentional for those, then the issue is only that it is also applied to routed (non-OpenAI) models that have a different real context.

issue.title: [Bug/UX] 用量 → 上下文的“现在”压缩窗口与 Long conversations 配置不一致，且随统计范围变化

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body: ## 问题 Long conversations 已设为 **480K**，生成的 Codex 模型目录和重启后的会话窗口都反映了这次设置，但「用量 → 上下文 → 为你调优 → Codex → 自动压缩」仍显示 **“现在 510K”**，同时显示 **“已是最适合你用法的最省配置”**。 希望确认“现在”表示已配置窗口、客户端有效窗口，还是所选历史范围的估算值。若是历史估算，当前标签容易让用户误以为设置未保存或未生效。**本报告不将根因预先定性为缓存 bug，也不主张 Codex 未读取配置。** ## 环境 - Windows 桌面环境 - Magpie **0.1.1985** - Codex 桌面版，app-server **0.165.0-alpha.1.2** - 使用 `magpie` provider 和第三方 API 模型；以下目录示例为 `zai/glm-5.3-flash`，不是官方 ChatGPT 订阅路径 - 核对日期：**2026-10-29** ## 配置与运行证据 Magpie 设置： ```json { "compactAt": 480000 } ``` `~/.codex/config.toml`： ```toml model_provider = "magpie" model_catalog_json = "magpie-models.json" ``` 没有手动设置 `model_context_window` 或 `model_auto_compact_token_limit`。 `~/.codex/magpie-models.json`： ```json { "slug": "zai/glm-5.3-flash", "context_window": 480000, "max_context_window": 1000000 } ``` 设置之后已重启 Codex。重启后的 rollout `token_count.info.model_context_window` 多次为 **456000**，包括 2026-10-29 10:25:02 和 10:25:27（UTC+8）。这与 `480000 × 95%` 相符，说明新工作窗口已被客户端读取。**这只是有效窗口元数据证据，并非已实际触发压缩、测得精确压缩触发点的证据。** ## 当前截图 截图拍摄于设置为 480K 并重启 Codex 后，显示： - “现在”：**510K** - “长对话”，Codex、Claude Code 和 Grok Build 共用 - “已是最适合你用法的最省配置” - Codex 3433 次调用 截图裁剪未包含时间范围选择器，因此不将它归属为某个确定的时间范围。 此前排查时还观察到：切换今天、7 天、30 天，卡片的“现在”分别显示约 670K、470K、390K。**这是更早、尚未设为当前 480K 时的观察，不是本次新截图在同一配置下的三组读数。** ## 观察步骤 1. 将 Codex 接入 Magpie，使用由 Magpie 生成的模型目录。 2. 将 Long conversations 设置为 480K。 3. 重启 Codex并发起请求，核对目录窗口为 480000、会话有效窗口为 456000。 4. 查看「用量 → 上下文 → 为你调优」；该机器上仍显示“现在 510K”。 5. 切换历史统计范围，比较“现在”与配置值是否一致。 这是已有长会话和历史数据上的实际观察；尚未在全新用户目录、单模型历史下独立复现。 ## 可能相关的代码路径（假设，待确认） 核对安装版本对应源码： - [`internal/gui/tune.go`](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/v0.1.1985/internal/gui/tune.go#L104-L172)：Codex 分支在 `Source == TuneLong` 时以 `told` 替换配置读出的 `cur`；`codexWindow` 若遇到历史模型无法匹配目录或窗口未知，可能返回 `told = 0`。 - [`internal/tune/tune.go`](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/v0.1.1985/internal/tune/tune.go#L350-L359)：`Current == 0` 时可回退到按历史压缩峰值等信息推断窗口。 - [`internal/gui/assets/context.js`](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/v0.1.1985/internal/gui/assets/context.js#L1417-L1446)：卡片把 `r.current` 标为 `Now`。 这条路径可能解释现象，但**尚未取得页面本次 `/api/tune` 响应来证明命中了该分支**，也未排除其他原因。 ## 期望 - 明确区分 **Long conversations 已配置值**、**客户端有效窗口**、**历史估算值** 和 **建议值**。 - 若无法推断统一生效窗口，标为“不确定／历史估算”，而非不加说明地标为“现在”。 - 切换统计范围可以改变建议值，但不应让用户误以为全局已保存配置也发生了变化。 相关但不同：#3553 讨论 Codex 的 95% 有效窗口；#1860 讨论选择推荐值以外的阈值。本报告聚焦设置成功后的调优卡片显示含义。 与 #3440、#2162 不同，本报告不讨论压缩策略是否覆盖客户端，而是 Long conversations 配置已被客户端读取后，调优卡片的“现在”仍显示不同数值、且缺少估算口径说明。
